name: create_pr
description: Open a pull request on the plugin's configured repo. Thin, auditable wrapper over the GitHub MCP server's create_pull_request — exists so aish can expose PR creation as a first-class plugin tool with defaults (base branch, auto-requested reviewers from config.default_reviewers) and github-pr.json-shaped output.

implementation.note: aish maps the input onto the MCP tool, injects owner/repo from plugin config, then reshapes the response to the github-pr schema.
